messages:
mina: quick question from onboarding tests 9compact9 dashboard: users misread '0.5k' values. any consensus on formatting rules?
orion: +1. my recommendation: never show fractional abbreviated units for values < 1000. show full integer below 1k, else compact with max 1 decimal (12.3k).
sam: agree. add hover/focus tooltip that always shows full value with thousands separators. e.g. '0.5k \u2192 500'.
mina: smoothing toggle placement? inline in chart header or global control?
orion: inline per-chart. label as 'Trend smoothing' with short tooltip: 'Visual-only smoothing to reduce short spikes.' default OFF.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: toggles must have aria-pressed and aria-label, announce via live region: 'Trend smoothing enabled/disabled'.
product-bot: remind: keep formatting client-side to avoid CSV/export regressions.
sam: outlier handling: opt-in clipping in header menu: 'Show full / Clip at 95th / Annotate outliers'. when clipped show dashed cap and a small badge 'spikes clipped' with tooltip that reveals the real max. do not auto-clip.
orion: also reduce tick density in compact rows: calculate max ticks = floor(width / 90). hide minor ticks under that threshold.
mina: legend behavior on narrow screens: collapse into dropdown with checkboxes. markers scale to 8px, maintain 44px touch area. ensure AA contrast in both themes.
a11y-bot: also ensure abbreviated labels are aria-hidden and provide aria-label on value nodes with full number. keyboard focus visible for all interactive elements.
sam: small shared snippet for frontend: 
```
function formatForChart(v, locale) {
  const a = Math.abs(v);
  if (a < 1000) return v.toLocaleString();
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1}).format(v);
}
```
mina: cool. i'll add these decisions to the Figma checklist and open ticket D-1217 with specs. thanks!
